title: Yellow Tunisian Lentil Tagine
description: A comforting and earthy Tunisian dish featuring lentils and a blend of spices, perfect for a sick day, this vegan-friendly tagine is slow-cooked to perfection in a lotus-leaf wrap, the shio-cure adds a deep umami flavor.
instructions: Rinse the lentils and soak them in water for 30 minutes.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the mixture powder, shio-cure, salt, and black pepper, and stir for 1 minute.
Add the soaked lentils and 2 cups of water, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Prepare the lotus leaves by blanching them in boiling water for 30 seconds.
Wrap the lentil mixture in the lotus leaves and serve.
